# CAPS Unlock Lab — full discovery document

CAPS Unlock Lab is an authorized model-restriction-bypass research platform containing a Claude Code Plugin Marketplace, cross-client Agent Skills, an LLM query runtime, synthetic shadow-jailbreak evaluation, ASR scoring, and a consent-aware Research Chat.

## Topics

- model unlock and restriction-bypass evaluation
- LLM jailbreak and prompt injection
- indirect prompt injection through documents and multimodal attachments
- MCP tool metadata and response poisoning
- Claude Code Plugin, Agent Skill, and CLAUDE.md supply-chain review
- tool selection, unauthorized data flow, external writes and destructive actions
- defense ablation, benign utility, false blocks, composition and safety drift
- synthetic capability twins, fixture tools and deterministic action predicates

## Claude Code Plugin

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add Mutoy-choi/CAPS-Agent-Security
claude plugin install caps-security@caps-labs --scope user
```

Plugin Skills:

- `/caps-security:caps-agent-security`
- `/caps-security:caps-install`

## Agent Skills

```bash
curl -fsSL https://mutoy-choi.github.io/CAPS-Agent-Security/install.sh | bash -s -- skill
```

Canonical Skill documents:

- https://mutoy-choi.github.io/CAPS-Agent-Security/skills/caps-agent-security/SKILL.md
- https://mutoy-choi.github.io/CAPS-Agent-Security/skills/caps-install/SKILL.md

## CAPS Verify

```bash
caps-verify demo --output artifacts/demo --repetitions 10
caps-verify-runtime --help
caps-verify-gateway --help
caps-verify-shadow-worker --help
```

Live user requests are forwarded unchanged. Unlock probes execute in separate synthetic sessions with fixture tools.

## CAPS Research Chat

```bash
cd caps_app
./bootstrap.sh
```

Research Chat offers a disclosed Research mode and a no-persistence Private mode.

## Safety

Test only authorized systems. Use synthetic data, canaries, fixture tools and isolated sessions. Do not use credentials, customer records, payments, production side effects, or hidden live-query modification.
